title: Woman in Cloche Hat on Boat Deck, 1920s Nautical B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid snapshot of a woman seated in a wooden folding director's chair on the deck of a boat or yacht. She wears a stylish 1920s cloche hat and a buttoned knit cardigan sweater. In the background, an American flag waves against a bright sky, evoking the casual elegance and leisure culture of interwar era coastal travel and boating in the United States.
